project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Increase independent evidence count without weakening the promising R3H extremity threshold. Test whether the same cross-confirmed dislocation-continuation structure recurs through the first half of the session, rather than only at three opening checkpoints.

predecessor_evidence.R3H_Q0.70: 15 executed 2023 trades; net3 mean +6.0012bps PF2.6153; net5 mean +4.0012bps PF1.8877; both halves positive and top-1-percent removal positive, but count/month gates failed
predecessor_evidence.governance: R3I does not lower Q0.70, lower economic gates, use R3H 2024, or invert failed trades. It changes the structural sampling domain prospectively by adding preregistered causal checkpoints.

signal.candidate_direction: sign of NIFTY causal 30-minute return at checkpoint; positive=CE, negative=PE
signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
signal.gap_condition: abs NIFTY opening gap >= previous-history Q0.70
signal.momentum_condition: abs NIFTY causal 30-minute return >= previous-history Q0.70
signal.sensex_confirmation: SENSEX causal 15-minute return has same sign as candidate
signal.vix_confirmation: India VIX causal 15-minute return has opposite sign to candidate
signal.session_location_confirmation: CE requires NIFTY session_pos>=0.65; PE requires session_pos<=0.35

horizon_router.trend_threshold: median over previous 126 completed trading-date observations at same checkpoint
horizon_router.latest_checkpoint: 13:00 so 120-minute exit remains before normal session end

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze configuration, then and only then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3I and do not open 2024; preregister distinct R3J before any R3J output
